unacceptable.summary: Practices prohibited in the EU regardless of context (e.g. social scoring by public authorities, manipulative AI, untargeted scraping for face databases, emotion recognition in workplace/schools with narrow exceptions, real-time remote biometric ID in public spaces with narrow judicial exception).

high.summary: Systems posing significant harm risk (safety, livelihoods, rights). Includes Annex III use cases (biometrics, critical infrastructure, education/vocational, employment/worker management, essential public/private services, law enforcement, migration/asylum/border, justice/ democratic processes) plus safety-component AI in regulated products.

limited.summary: Transparency obligations: disclose to users they interact with AI (chatbots, deepfakes/synthetic media, emotion/intention classification, AI-generated text published on behalf of a person).

minimal.summary: All other AI with negligible risk (spam filters, AI in games, inventory recommendation). No obligations beyond voluntary codes.

prohibitedPractices.title: Exploitation of vulnerability (age, disability, social/economic) causing harm
Untargeted scraping of facial images to build face databases
Emotion recognition in workplace/schools (narrow medical/security exceptions)
Real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces (narrow law-enforcement judicial exception)

articles.title: Classification rules for high-risk
obligations: Apply Art. 43 conformity assessment if safety-component of regulated product

articles.title: Data and data governance
obligations: Training/validation/test sets relevant, representative, free of errors

articles.title: Record-keeping (logging)
obligations: Automatic logging of events during operation
Capability retained for duration of risk

articles.title: Transparency and provision of information
obligations: Make clear to deployers they use high-risk AI

articles.title: Human oversight
obligations: Allow natural persons to understand/interpret output

articles.title: Registration in EU database
obligations: Standalone high-risk systems registered in EU database

articles.title: Deployer obligations
obligations: Do not input profiling data unless permitted

articles.title: Obligations of deployers in high-risk employment/education
obligations: Carry out fundamental rights impact assessment (Art. 27(2)) where likely to be used

articles.title: Transparency obligations (limited-risk)
obligations: Disclose AI-generated text published on behalf of a person

deadlines.obligation: Entry into force; minimal-risk voluntary codes apply
GPAI rules (Art. 51-55), governance, penalties apply (Digital Omnibus adjusted)
Limited-risk transparency (Art. 50); high-risk for products under regulated sector harmonised standards
Annex III high-risk obligations (most use cases) apply — post Digital Omnibus delay
High-risk obligations for certain public authorities (transitional, Digital Omnibus)
